mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (guest_user_id, place_id, reservation_no, reservation_type, check_in_at, check_out_at, status, request_message, total_price) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{reservationNo},#{reservationType, typeHandler=com.example.petnow.mapper.handler.ReservationTypeHandler}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{totalPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.status AS status, r.reservation_no AS reservation_no, r.check_in_at AS check_in_at, r.check_out_at AS check_out_at, u.nickname AS user_name, pl.name AS place_name, p.id AS pet_id, p.name AS pet_name, p.weight AS pet_weight, LOWER(p.size) AS pet_size FROM reservations r INNER JOIN users u ON r.guest_user_id = u.id INNER JOIN places pl ON r.place_id = pl.id LEFT JOIN reservation_pets rp ON r.id = rp.reservation_id LEFT JOIN pets p ON rp.pet_id = p.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, pl.name AS placeName, r.total_price AS totalPrice, r.status AS reservationStatus, r.check_in_at AS checkIn, r.check_out_at AS checkOut FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN places pl ON r.place_id = pl.id
r.guest_user_id = #{userId}
AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.check_in_at > NOW()
AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND NOW() BETWEEN r.check_in_at AND r.check_out_at
AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.check_out_at < NOW()
ORDER BY r.check_in_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status='CANCELED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status != 'CANCELED'
UPDATE reservations SET status='CONFIRMED', responded_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status='PENDING'
